verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly shows that Bitbucket Server/Data Center editions exist. It refers to customers holding a Bitbucket Data Center license and to a migration app that moves code and users from Server or Data Center to Cloud, which implies a self-managed deployment of the core product. Private CI runners and on-prem CI integrations are adjacent features and earn no credit. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs describing Data Center as a self-hosted install, deployment and installation requirements, current availability and support status (the evidence frames it mainly as something to migrate away from), and independent hands-on corroboration of self-hosting.
